transcription.note: Only the window that overlaps the recommended trip is transcribed here, because that is the window the day plan acts on. Every row was read from the official PDF's REG CLOSES column, which is the only place the late-registration cut-off is published as a clock time. Blank cells in the PDF (Day 2 restarts, the RaceDay events with no guarantee) are blank here too; they are never inferred.
